scope: Independent privacy, source-terms and license review of each loose and nested member of the exact frozen 1.0.0 technical candidate. Each item decision is bound to its SHA-256; any changed asset byte requires a bounded rebind review.

privacy.wheel_contents: Project Python/R source, public catalogs, schemas, bounded test fixtures, four DejaVu fonts with notice, and package metadata; no installed dependencies or native PDF toolchain.
privacy.archive_contents: The 73 sealed research files, original manifest and receipt, and nine release-context files: MIT license, bilingual README and notices, source details, prior evidence and attributable supplemental review.
privacy.unchanged_content_review: docs/evidence/phase-05-independent-review.json: 6739 public records, 3565 suppressed values with null sensitive diagnostics, 22 public DuckDB tables and no named person columns. Reused only because all 73 content hashes match.

licenses_and_terms.inegi_terms_result: Official terms allow copies, publication, adaptation and extraction with retained metadata, INEGI and product credit, transformation disclosure and no implied endorsement. The sealed report and bundled notices meet these attribution boundaries; raw microdata remain excluded.

limits: This technical approval binds only the five listed v6 candidate asset hashes and 147 nested member hashes; any changed asset byte requires a bounded rebind review.
The credential and private-path scan is targeted to stated patterns, not an exhaustive secret proof.
Human visual acceptance, installed portability receipts, draft upload and anonymous public byte readback remain separate release gates.

item_decisions.basis: Sealed Phase 4 aggregate report; unchanged hash and attribution reviewed.
